system.description: Make an attack against a foe with your chosen weapon. If you hit, you inflict 1 less damage than normal, but you disarm your foe, knocking their weapon to the ground 10 feet (3.5 m) away. If your chosen weapon is a whip, you can instead choose to hinder your attack, and if it succeeds, the foe's weapon lands in your other hand. If your chosen weapon is a bow, you can instead choose to hinder your attack, and if it succeeds, the foe's weapon is “nailed” to a nearby object or structure. Action.
